- Word size 4B vs 8B ambiguous. Example spacing (4194304→4194308, diff=4) implies 32-bit words, but ELF64/x86-64 GOT/.dynamic entries natively 8B — 4B-only extraction risks splitting/misaligning 8B values.
- Signedness unspecified in spec ("integer") — no overflow risk seen in these two example values (<2^31), but any real word ≥0x80000000 renders differently signed vs unsigned; spec silent on which.
